# Polymer slot parity

<!-- Generated by scripts/parity/render-parity.mjs; edit the contracts, then run npm run render:polymer-parity. -->

Compares the slot hosts and default contributions of Polymer Nuxeo Web UI `e0ccb8661` (https://github.com/nuxeo/nuxeo-web-ui, Apache-2.0) with this repository's defaults. A migrated Polymer override that names a Polymer default targets the Angular IDs listed here.

Status: **mapped** has Angular equivalents, **gap** has none in core, **addon** comes from a Polymer add-on this repository does not ship. Host placement and slot-model fields are compared under Hosts and Slot models.

## Slot models

Polymer merges a shared model (`user`, set in `elements/nuxeo-app.js`) into every slot's model, and each host adds its own fields. Angular's slot hosts (`nx-webui-slot`, `nx-document-views`) add the signed-in user from `WebUiAppState` the same way; a host's own `user` wins. The rest of nuxeo-app's model (clipboard, tasks, personal workspace, route, Nuxeo URL) is read from `WebUiAppState`. Status: **mapped** has Angular context properties, **replaced** has an SDK API outside the context, **gap** has none, **dropped** has no use to carry over. `verify:polymer-parity` checks the Angular properties against each slot's context type.

## Document layouts

Polymer's `nuxeo-document-layout` loads `<type>/nuxeo-<type>-<mode>-layout.html`, both lowercased, and shows a not-found error when the file is missing. Every Polymer per-type layout resource at this revision is registered in `default-document-layouts.ts`; `verify:polymer-parity` checks the list.

| Mode       | Polymer resources |
| ---------- | ----------------- |
| `create`   | 13                |
| `edit`     | 20                |
| `import`   | 5                 |
| `metadata` | 19                |
| `view`     | 19                |

`DocumentLayoutRegistry` matches the lowercased type and the mode, then applies priority and `when`. Where Polymer shows a not-found error, the view, create/edit and import hosts fall back to a generic component. Polymer has no list or grid card layouts; `provideResultsProjections()` replaces cards per type.

### Define a layout for a custom type

Types without a pinned resource (Studio and add-on types, whatever their names) get no view, create, edit or import layout and are served in `metadata` mode by the wildcard layout `default.document-layout.any.metadata` (`FALLBACK_METADATA_LAYOUT` in `default-document-layouts.ts`). It mounts `DefaultDocumentMetadataLayoutComponent`, which lists the document's properties from the server schema (`/api/v1/config/types/{type}`), grouped by schema in server order, with labels humanised from property names. When it is used, the browser console shows one `[maretha-angular-webui]` notice per type and session. Types that stock Web UI registers with `no-layout` (`Document`, `Comment`, `SavedSearch`, `UserProfile`, `TemplateBasedFile` and the rest of `STOCK_NO_LAYOUT_TYPES` in `helpers/fallback-document-layouts.ts`) are excluded: no wildcard layout serves them, matching stock.

To give a type its own layout, register a `DocumentLayoutExtension` with `provideDocumentLayoutExtensions()` from the SDK:

```ts
provideDocumentLayoutExtensions({
  id: 'acme.invoice-layouts',
  layouts: [
    {
      id: 'acme.invoice.metadata',
      documentType: 'AcmeInvoice',
      mode: 'metadata',
      component: InvoiceMetadataComponent,
    },
    {
      id: 'acme.invoice.view',
      documentType: 'AcmeInvoice',
      mode: 'view',
      component: InvoiceViewComponent,
    },
  ],
});
```

A metadata component must declare `layoutContext`, `document`, `embedded`, `noEdit` and `externalToolbar` inputs (extend `DefaultDocumentMetadataLayoutComponent` to inherit them). Typed entries always beat the wildcard; use `priority` to order several entries for one type and `when(context)` to narrow by facet or document state. See the schema-bound layouts in `app/extensions/README.md` for field-level rendering.

## Non-slot customizations

Polymer customization resources outside slots and document layouts. Status: **supported** has an SDK registration API, **server** needs no UI migration, **waived** has no SDK equivalent and follows the guidance.

| Surface                  | Polymer resources | Status    | Angular                                                                                                                  |
| ------------------------ | ----------------- | --------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Search forms and results | 6                 | waived    | The built-in searches are contributions, mapped below. The SDK has no search-form layout registry.                       |
| Workflow task layouts    | 6                 | supported | `provideWorkflowLayout({ id, taskKey, component, priority })`. Every Polymer task layout has a default at priority -100. |
| Themes                   | 4                 | supported | `THEMES` contributions (`defineWebUiTheme`). Every Polymer theme is a default.                                           |
| Page providers           | 12                | server    | Server page providers keep their names; the Angular UI queries them over REST.                                           |
| Custom elements          | –                 | waived    | Polymer elements do not run in the Angular UI.                                                                           |

### Guidance

- **Search forms and results**: Port a custom Polymer search as `DRAWER_ITEMS` and `DRAWER_PAGES` (or `PAGES`) contributions under `custom/` whose component queries `/api/v1/search/pp/<provider>/execute`.
- **Workflow task layouts**: Register a custom task layout with `provideWorkflowLayout`. `taskKey` is the task's layout resource name without the `nuxeo-` prefix, or its `task<hex>` node ID, lowercased. A priority above -100 replaces a default.
- **Themes**: Generate a theme with `npm run new:contribution -- --slot THEMES`. Its tokens use the Polymer `--nuxeo-*` variable names.
- **Page providers**: Page provider definitions are server contributions (Studio or XML) and need no UI migration. A component under `custom/` queries one through `/api/v1/search/pp/<name>/execute`.
- **Custom elements**: Rewrite each element as an Angular component under `custom/` and register it as a slot contribution, document layout, page or workflow layout (`npm run new:contribution`, `npm run new:layout`).
